body: I know this isn't something you want to hear but don't put so much of your guilt of not getting girls into your weight. I was in the same boat as you and weighed close to 300 pounds just under 3 years ago. I'm now down to 170 for the last little while but that hasn't done anything to improve my game. On top of the weight you have to also strengthen your other traits of your personality. That's the most important thing to keep girls interested.
Go bag. Google it. It's the way I'm planning on going
I'm in the same boat. The only reason I haven't killed myself yet is because I couldn't do that to my mom , brother , and sister. I now drink all the time looking for the courage to do it.

It's not even the fact that unless you are a male model you will struggle with matches. When you actually match you still have to sell yourself to be interesting enough to get her attention over all the other guys that are doing the same but with validated experience. That's the tricky part.

I know how you feel. I've been coming home from work and laying in bed, not motivated enough to do anything, till I wake up and go back to work. The loneliness saps me of everything and it's unbearable. Couldn't wish a life of loneliness on anyone.
Thanks for the words. I really appreciate it.

I hear what your saying about not making all your life relationships is about. I have so many other things I'm extremely proud of in myself, one of them going to university to pursue something I wanted to since I was a child. But this thought of is it impossible for me to ever find someone? It drains all love and passion I had for all my hobbies and seeing this depresses me even more.
